poc_results_summary: Observed average QPS during pilot: 9.8 QPS (steady-state), bursts up to 125 QPS for 2-4 minutes during feature releases.
Token mix: 65% inference tokens (generation/response), 35% input/embedding tokens. Average tokens per API call: 420 (stdev 110).
Concurrency: median 18, typical sustained concurrency 35 during business hours, P95 concurrency observed 92 (release hot windows).
Latency: hosted API P50 120ms, P95 220ms for model v1; heavier summarization flows hit P95 ~420ms on hosted trial (calls >1200 tokens).
Quality: 1.2% regression on rerank NDCG vs internal baseline when using quantized variant; acceptable for non-transactional search results, not for final-summarize.
Ops telemetry: prefix cache hit rate 28% with naive caching; expected improvements to 60% with recommended cache rules.
dedicated_sizing_forecast: Redwood SE recommended baseline: 2 x A100-equivalent serving nodes (4 GPUs each) for sustained 40 QPS low-latency LLM workloads with current token mix.
Sizing for production with 3x headroom: 6 GPUs (2 nodes) for steady traffic; add burst pool (2 nodes) to handle 120 QPS spikes with graceful fallback — suggest autoscale min 2 nodes, max 4 nodes.
Estimated concurrent KV cache memory: 220GB across serving pool; KV cache recommended to reduce per-token compute for repeated prefixes.
Expected token throughput per A100-eq GPU: ~120k tokens/min under observed request mix; internal calc attached in deck appendix.
Cost estimate delta: Dedicated (committed) predicted to reduce per-token bill by ~48% vs hosted at observed usage — assuming 12-month commit and optimized batching.
Routing policy: prefer Dedicated for all traffic >10 QPS; route to Hosted as overflow for burst >95 QPS and during maintenance windows.
